questions.q: What historic firsts did Kamala Harris achieve as Vice President?
a: First female, first Black, first Indian‑descent VP
questions.why: Intro overview lists those three milestones.

questions.q: Which university inspired Harris to pursue law after she admired civil‑rights lawyers?
questions.why: She realized at Howard she wanted to be a lawyer.

questions.q: What program did Harris create to give non‑violent first‑time offenders alternatives to prison?
questions.why: She pioneered the Back on Track program.

questions.q: How does legal representation affect asylum seekers' chance of winning their case?
questions.why: Text states 50% chance with representation, 90% without.

questions.q: What issue did Harris address as San Francisco DA related to the War on Drugs?
questions.why: She tackled injustices such as mass incarceration caused by the War on Drugs.
